summary: Join our Self-Service BI Tools training course tailored for executives. Learn to harness data effectively and transform insights into strategic actions.
lede: Self-service business intelligence helps executives interpret dashboards and reports for strategic decision-making. Designed for senior leaders, the course covers how to read KPIs, explore trends with filters and drill-downs, and identify anomalies or gaps in data. Participants also practise questioning assumptions and using findings to support performance reviews, budgeting, and risk monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior leaders who must interpret data to make strategic decisions.
audience: Public sector decision makers and policy managers
modules: Introduction to Self-Service BI for Executives
Asking the Right Questions of Your Data
Using BI Tools to Evaluate Strategy and Performance
Exploring Data Using Filters, Drill-Downs, and Comparisons
BI for Budgeting and Resource Allocation
BI for Risk Monitoring and Executive Oversight
Data Pitfalls and Cognitive Biases Leaders Should Avoid
Turning BI Insights Into Executive Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of business operations and key performance indicators. No prior BI experience is required, but familiarity with Excel or similar tools is beneficial.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
